The '''Verdier Luxline''' was a model of luxury [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] that was used in the galaxy during the [[Third Galactic War]]. The Luxline featured a supercharged turbine which allowed the speeder to reach must faster speeds.<ref name="Bundle" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Verdier Luxline was a player mount in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It was added to the game in Game Update 7.7.1 as a reward for the Galactic Seasons 9 event.<ref name="update">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250730|text=Game Update 7.7.1 Livestream Recap}}</ref> In-game, the Verdier Luxline allowed the player to travel as if they have achieved Speeder Piloting III, whilst only having Speeder Piloting I. Additionally, the max speed increases, resulting in a top speed of 130% compared to regular in-game mounts.<ref name="Bundle" />
